paite: Huchi in Israel upa khenkhatte ka kiang ah ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu ua.
heading: Pathian In Milim Biak Mohpaih

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta, ka kiang ah;
"Mihing tapa, hiai mite'n amilimte uh alungtang uah alalut ua, ama uah athulimlouhna pukna uh akoih uhi; kei ahon dong peuhmah ding ua hia?"

Huaiziak in amau houpih inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel inkuan a michih alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua athulimlouhna pukna koih a, zawlnei kiang a hong pai peuhmah, kei TOUPA'N amilim uh tamdan bang zel in ka dawng ding.
Israel inkote amilim uh ziak a hon na omtuamsan ziak ua alungtang ua ka mattheihna ding in."
Huaiziak in Israel inkote kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hong kik unla, na milimte ua kipan in hong kik un, na kihhuaina tengteng uh lehngatsan un.

"Israel inkote lak a mi kuapeuh hiam, mikhual Israel gam a teng hiam, kei a kipan a kihihtuam, alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua thulimlouhna pukna koih kawm a, atungtang ua hon dong ding a zawlnei kiang a hoh kei leh TOUPA ngei in ka dawng ding hi.
Huai mi ka masuan ding a, mi'n lamdang asak ding in tangtawn tangtawn a gen ding in ka mite lak a kipan ka hihmang ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uhi.
"Huan zawlnei khem a om in thu gen henla, kei TOUPA'N zawlnei ka thuzoh ahi a, atung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka mi Israelte lak a kipan ka hihmang ding.
Athulimlouhna uh apo ding ua; zawlnei thulimlouhna amah dong mite thulimlouhna bang mai ahi ding hi.

Israel inkote kei a kipan aman nawn louh ua, atatleknate tengteng ua akihihnit nawn samlouhna ding un, ka mite ahih zawk ua a Pathian uh ka hihtheihna ding in, Toupa PATHIAN in achi, chi in gen in," achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Noah, Daniel Leh Job

paite: "Mihing tapa, gam mite'n tatlekna thilhih a, ka tung a thil hihkhial a, ke'n ka khut ka lik a, a-an uh, hinna bul ka hihsiat a, atung ua kial ka tunsak a, mi leh sate ka hon hihmanleh hiai mi thum,
Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng hong om bang hileh, adiktatna un amau hinna kia a humbit ding ahi," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Gam sahangte a gam uh ka tuansuaksak a, gam ahihsiat ua, ahong kigawp a, gamsa ziak a kuamah paisuak ding a-om kei uleh,
hiai mi thumte om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding uh; amau kia hotdam in a-om ding ua, gam asegawp ding hi.
Ahihkeileh huai gam ah namsau ka lik dia, "Namsau aw, gamsung teng tawnsuak in," mi leh gamsa ka gawimang ding hi.
Hiai mi thumte om le uh leng, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding ua, amau hinna kia humbit in a-om ding uh.
Ahihkeileh, huai gam ah, hipi ka hon lensak a, mi leh sa hihmang ding a sisan suah a ka hehna huai gam tung a ka hon sunleh;
Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng na om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanu uhiam, atapa uhiam ahumbit kei ding ua, adiktatna un amau hinna ngei ahumbit lel ding uhi.

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a, "Jerusalem tung a ka vaihawmna na mahmah lite, namsaute, kialte, gam sahangte, hipite, mi leh sa gawimang vek ding a ka hon tut hun chiang in bangzah a thupi ahi diam aw?

Himahleh ngai in, huai lai a akhosuaksun pikhiak dingte nutsiat in a-om ding ua, tanute leh tapate leng; ngai un, akiang uah ahong pawtkhe ding ua, a-omdan uh athilhihte na mu ding uh, Jerusalem tung a thil hoih lou ka hon tut thu ah lungmuan in na om ding ua, atung a ka hon tut tengteng thu ah leng.
A-omdan uleh athilhihte uh na muh hun chiang un ahon lungmuan ding uh; atung a ka thilhih tengteng hihsan nei lou in ka hih kei chih na thei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
